theorems.Etna.Design.Current.Protocol.RecoveryNon: Joint realization (design 4.6): one environment, registry and engine satisfy H1-H3's fifteen Premises and H4's RecoveryPremises together, with a reachable initialized world satisfying LiveAt, so all four claims can hold of one deployment. Restrictions: a new network only (no Unzen inbox, so the Unzen premises and LiveAt.unzen are vacuous); one online key, which signs every vote, backs the only registered bond and alone forms every committee; a single catalogue definition for every ruleset, which checks only that a block's EL hash is the injective code of its EL fields and its Comet hash the injective code of the other header fields, and accepts every payload; a classical verifier that is an ideal sound-and-complete checker (it accepts exactly the statements an image certifies over the L1 prefix their reference hash commits to), not an oracle for a World. Some premises hold trivially by permissive choices: the engine attributes every precommit (currentVoteAttribution), env.payload accepts any one to six blobs whatever the blocks (PayloadLive), and the verifier ignores version, backend and proof bytes. The world has not landed yet; no standalone rule credit.
